newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adelaide Brighton to sell Direct Mix group.
newsitem.headline: Adelaide Brighton to sell Direct Mix group.

text.p: Building products group Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Thursday it had contracted to sell its interest in the Direct Mix Group to existing shareholders.
Adelaide Brighton did not disclose the price, but said the sale would result in an abnormal book loss of about A$8 million to be reflected in the results for the year to June 30, 1997.
Managing director Richard Hammond said in a statement the Direct Mix operation had been sustaining losses and did not form part of the group's core business.

Hammond said a nominal interest only would be retained in the Direct Mix group in parallel with long-term cement supply contracts, which protected the interest of the owners of Direct Mix as well as Adelaide Brighton.
Adelaide Brighton shares ended four cents lower at A$2.05.
